name: Mike Hawthorn
features: tall, fair wavy hair, ruddy complexion, broad grin, bow tie worn under the overalls, relaxed confident bearing
bio: The first British World Champion, in 1958, by a single point over Moss — and with only one win to Moss\u2019s four. Raced in a bow tie and made no secret of enjoying himself. Won the 1955 Le Mans in the Jaguar whose pit stop triggered the disaster, which shadowed him afterwards. Retired the moment he took the title and was killed on the Guildford bypass three months later.
